caption: The drawing shows a symmetrical, colorful architectural or decorative panel composed mainly of rectangular and arch shapes. The central upper section features a vertical black cross on a background of cream with floral patterns that include two large, green, artichoke-like thistles and small red flowers with green stems. Above this central panel, in a semicircular arched area bordered in red and blue, is a stylized dove with white wings and a yellow body, surrounded by a blue background. On either side of the vertical cross, there are two vertical, rectangular brown panels framed in blue and red, with a fan-shaped red and white motif along the top of each. These side panels are taller than wide and are mirrored on both sides of the composition. At the top corners, red scrollwork adds decorative detail. Between the upper and lower halves, there is a narrow horizontal band patterned with small rectangles in green, red, black, and white. The lower section of the drawing features a central archway with draped blue and red curtains over a cream background decorated with small circles or flower-like shapes, set above a blank white rectangle. Flanking the archway are four tall, narrow brown vertical panels with rounded red arch outlines on a cream background, two on each side. The drawing is outlined with a thin black line and uses a color palette of red, cream, blue, green, brown, black, and yellow. The entire composition is contained within a plain beige border.
title: Main Reredos in Santa Cruz Church, Santa Fe County
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
